relevance_note: The paper describes five individually identifiable children with heterozygous TNFAIP3 variants and a diagnosis of HA20 ("Five children with HA20 were confirmed in the Gastroenterology Department of Henan Children's Hospital"), each with sex, variant, clinical features and treatment.
method_note: Read the whole Markdown file, including the Supplementary material section. No script was used; every value was read by hand and each span was checked against the file by eye. Tables 1-3 have patients as columns (Table 3 also has two columns for patients of other authors); I quoted the relevant row from its label through the last cell, and recorded which column belongs to which patient in this note. No table cell in this paper contains ' / ' stacked values (the single '/' cells are missing-value marks, treated as not reported), so nothing was dropped for stacking. Contradictions found: (1) Table 1 and Table 3 give 'Oral ulcers: NO' for Patient 2, but the Discussion says 'patient 2 had rash, gastrointestinal ulcers, and oral ulcers'; I emitted both an observed and an excluded phenotypic_features row for Patient 2 and left the checklist item 'oral ulcers' as not reported. (2) Table 3's header row labels the c.133C>T columns 'Patient 3' and 'The case reported by Zhong et al.', while Table 1 and the text assign c.133C>T: p. R45X to Patient 4 (and c.1243_1247delAAAAC to Patient 2); I followed Table 1 and the text. (3) Figure 1(E) prints 'NC000006.11: g.136693638138817508del' without separators, the text prints 'NC_000006.11:g.136693638_138817508del'; I used the text form. Other judgement calls: the Table 1 note 'TNFAIP3 transcript: NM_006290.5' is a table-level statement about the five named patients and was recorded as the transcript for all five; the Discussion's onset ages are paired with patients only positionally ('patients 2, 5), with onset ages of 6 months and 1 year 6 months'), so I recorded no onset age from those sentences except for patient 3, where the sentence names the patient and the age. I did not use the Discussion statements about OTU/ZnF domain variants in general (from cited literature) to exclude features for individual patients, and the development delay of patients 1 and 5 was not mapped to 'central nervous system involvement'. No study inclusion/exclusion criterion was used as evidence. Two MMACHC variants of patient 3 are recorded in the variants table (unambiguously attributed); their inheritance is given in the abstract as 'c.349G>C: p.A117P-–inherited from the parents and c.482G>A: p.R161Q -– de novo', and I quoted the ASCII fragments 'inherited from the parents' and 'de novo'.
